title.zh: 澳大利亚拟将加密资产结算衍生品纳入杠杆限制，征求意见至11月9日
title.en: 澳大利亚拟将加密资产结算衍生品纳入杠杆限制，征求意见至11月9日

current_state.zh: Australia's ASIC proposed broadening CFD rules to cover contracts settled in digital assets — subjecting them to leverage limits, close-out triggers and negative-balance protection — and opened consultation on the plan until November 9.
current_state.en: Australia's ASIC proposed broadening CFD rules to cover contracts settled in digital assets — subjecting them to leverage limits, close-out triggers and negative-balance protection — and opened consultation on the plan until November 9.
